name: PDF Arranger
blurb: PDF Arranger is a small application, which helps the user to merge or split pdf documents and rotate, crop and rearrange their pages using an interactive and intuitive graphical interface.
description:
PDF Arranger is a small application, which helps the user to merge or split pdf
documents and rotate, crop and rearrange their pages using an interactive and
intuitive graphical interface.

It is a frontend for pikepdf.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
